title: LatchGitWorktreeOpenV2
description: GET /v2/git/worktree/open?path= requires an active paired device with Control access. The absolute source path must canonically resolve to the worktree root. Root aliases and linked worktrees are accepted. Nested folders return worktree_root_required and bare repositories return bare_repository.

worktreeRef.description: Opaque reference scoped to the current host gateway, paired device, Control grant revision and exact worktree. Use it for GET /v2/git/worktree/status?worktreeRef= and GET /v2/git/worktree/diff?worktreeRef=&file=&area=&cursor=. References expire after 30 minutes and may be evicted sooner. A stale, foreign or unknown reference returns 409 stale_worktree_ref. Lost Control access returns 403. Reopen on the authenticated host when needed.
